question:
A POAP-enabled Cisco Nexus switch will not enter POAP mode.
Which two conditions should be verified? (Choose two.)
options: The switch is in bootup process.
The license file is missing on the switch.
Bootflash must contain a special directory named POAP with poap.py file.
No Cisco NX-OS image is present on the bootflash.
theory: POAP only auto-triggers under two conditions: the switch has no startup configuration present, and it is going through its very first power-up/setup sequence — that combination is literally the entry criteria the switch checks before entering POAP mode. If a startup configuration already exists, or the device isn't in that initial bootup process, POAP will not start regardless of licensing or bootflash directory contents. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 17 — Evaluate Automation and Orchestration Technologies)
